units.source_text: 正是‘丧服破绽垂线缕……’”末了数字轻微得听不见，

en.t: It was just, 'The mourning robe is torn, its threads hang loose...' but the last few words were so faint they could not be heard,

units.source_text: 吟罢悲伤难忍，就退回内室去。

en.t: and when she finished reciting it, unable to bear her grief, she withdrew into the inner room.

units.source_text: 薰君此时未便勉强挽留她，但意犹未尽，不胜怅惘。

en.t: At that moment Lord Kaoru could not very well force her to stay, but his feelings were still unresolved, and he was overwhelmed with melancholy.
